many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

from collections import Counter,defaultdict
def load():

    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
pairs=[(np.array(G['Demo pair %d input'%i]),np.array(G['Demo pair %d output'%i])) for i in range(1,5)]
# Build feature tables per cell: for each color v, count #quads where pixel==v; also flags vs bgs/noises
data=[]
for gi,oo in pairs:
    h,w=gi.shape
    qs=[gi[:h//2,:w//2], gi[:h//2,w//2:], gi[h//2:,:w//2], gi[h//2:,w//2:]]
    bgs=[int(q.flat.mean()) if False else int(Counter(q.flat).most_common(1)[0][0]) for q in qs]
    noises=[]

        c=Counter(q.flat); rest=[k for k,v in c.items() if k!=b]

    H,W=oo.shape

import numpy as np
from collections import Counter
# Verify rule: out = value appearing exactly once in t
def f(g):
    g=np.array(g); h,w=g.shape
    qs=[g[:h//2,:w//2],g[:h//2,w//2:],g[h//2:,:w//2],g[h//2:,w//2:]]
    qH,qW=h//2,w//2
    out=[[0]*qW for _ in range(qH)]
    for r in range(qH):
        for c in range(qW):
            t=tuple(int(q[r,c]) for q in qs)
            cnt=Counter(t)
            # unique-counting: out = value with count 1, smallest if tie / none if ambiguous
            ones=[k for k,v in cnt.items() if v==1]
            if ones: out[r][c]=min(ones)
            else:
                # rarest overall
                mn=min(cnt.values())
                out[r][c]=min(k for k,v in cnt.items() if v==mn)
    return out
